title: Saucy Maple Fondants
description: Straightforward fondant puddings with a nutty, sweet maple centre that oozes out when cut. Don't overcook — the sauce needs to stay liquid.
steps: Grease 4 ramekins and line bases with greaseproof paper circles.
Mix 150g of the maple syrup with the sifted flour. In a separate bowl whisk the whole eggs and yolks together for a couple of minutes. Add to the maple mixture and whisk.
Divide between the ramekins (about two-thirds full) and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Meanwhile, spoon remaining 50g syrup into 4 ice-cube tray squares and freeze.
Preheat oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Drop a frozen maple syrup cube into the centre of each ramekin.
Bake for 20–22 minutes until just set on top. Turn out on to plates immediately and serve with whipped cream.
notes: Makes 4 fondants. Eat while hot to see the syrupy centre flow out.
